name: Nur Islamic School of Louisville
mission: Our holistic education aims to provide the environment for the total and balanced development of every student in every sphere of learning – spiritual, moral, imaginative, intellectual, cultural, aesthetic, emotional, and physical – directing all these aspects towards the attainment of a conscious relationship with God, the ultimate purpose of our life.
theoryOfChange: We believe that knowledge is holistic and it comprises of the divine revelation and the rational and intellectual knowledge (i.e., the scientific method). Therefore, Islamic holistic education, there is no compartmentalization of knowledge into religious and secular.The vast majority of educational systems are concerned and occupied only with mental capacities. The Islamic holistic educational system focuses on the instruction and training of the mind and the soul as well; therefore, education is a combination of transmission of knowledge and training of the soul and personality . At NISL, we take a student-centered approach, focusing on individual growth of every student in all academic subjects.  Teachers at Nur Islamic School of Louisville not only work to ensure students learn the academics, but also focus on other critical areas of growth.  Success is not simply measured by which the standardized achievement test or which top high school or college you get into, but it is defined by how well each of us has grown in our intellectual, emotional, social and ethical development.  We believe that excellence must be a continuous pursuit and our measurements include becoming life-long learners and critical thinkers.
